title: 5x Desserts Ferocious | 70/30 Shortfill Bundle
description:
Ferocious Desserts 70/30 E-Liquid Bundle Pack:
If you’re a fan of our Ferocious dessert flavored 70/30 vape juices then you’re going to love this bundle! We’ve bundled together our most tasty dessert Ferocious 70/30 Shortfills so you can save money, whilst stocking up on your favorite E-liquids for no extra cost.
Butterscotch Custard
–
Warm, vanilla custard topped with a swirl of deliciously sweet and sticky butterscotch sauce.
Vanilla Custard Delight
–
Smooth and creamy custard, sweet but not sickly, and just the right amount of warm vanilla.
New York Cheesecake
–
Rich cream and vanilla flavors with a digestive biscuit base then added just the right amount of citrus undertones to balance out the sweetness.
Birthday Cake
–
Layers of freshly baked Victoria sponge cake with a luscious layer of authentic, rich vanilla icing.
Ice Pop
–
Jam-packed with berry and cherry flavors , rounded off with a shot of ice for maximum refreshment!
Vape juice is made with a 70/30 mix (70% VG to 30% PG). As VG is thicker than PG, you’ll need a high-powered Sub Ohm device to ensure the E-liquid is vaporized correctly. Our Ferocious Flavors Vape Liquids are available in a variety of quantities and intensities.
120ml Shortfill Bottles of 0mg 70/30 vape juice are available. If you want to add nicotine to your Shortfills, we have 100ml and 120ml bottles available with 3mg and 6mg nicotine strengths. We have 0mg, 3mg and 6mg,  in stock, so you can just pop it into your tank and start vaping right away!
Ingredients
Vegetable Glycerine (70%)
Propylene Glycol (30%)
Vapoholic Flavouring
Nicotine Free, Freebase Nicotine, Or Nicotine Salts
What’s in the Bundle?
1x Butterscotch Custard Shortfill
1x Vanilla Custard Shortfill
1x New York Cheesecake Shortfill
1x Birthday Cake Shortfill
1x Ice Pop Shortfill
Specifications:

Highlights:
5x dessert flavoured Ferocious E-liquids for you to try!
Delicious flavours in a 70/30 mix for sub-ohm vaping!
Perfect for cloud-chasing vapers
5 popular indulgent E-liquids bundled together to save you even more money
